subject: Urgent Reorder: Fine Crystal Sugar for Week 42
content:
Dear Mr. Turner,

Further to our framework agreement, and due to an unexpectedly high order volume for our 'Sea Salt Edition', we need to adjust our raw material planning at short notice.

We urgently require an additional delivery of 2 tonnes of fine crystal sugar, which must arrive at our goods-in department no later than next Tuesday. Could you please check the feasibility of this unscheduled delivery as soon as possible?

We would be very grateful for a brief confirmation of the delivery date.

Kind regards,

Your Purchasing Team

subject: Important Notice: Maintenance Work on Cooking Kettle 3
content:
Dear colleagues in Production,

Please note the following change to the operating schedule: this coming Friday, from 2:00 pm, necessary technical maintenance (descaling and seal inspection) will be carried out on Cooking Kettle 3.

This means the unit will be unavailable for the rest of the late shift. Please adjust the shift planning accordingly to avoid a backlog in processing the cream-caramel mass.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Technical Management

subject: Feedback on the Holiday Edition Designs / Material Review
content:
Hi Ms. Weber,

I have taken a close look at the current design drafts for the Holiday Edition. Overall the design is very appealing, but there are technical concerns regarding feasibility.

The gold finish looks excellent on screen, but the practical test with the sample piece showed that the color chips at the edges as soon as the candy is twisted. This does not meet our quality standards for premium products.

I suggest we get together soon to discuss alternative materials or printing methods.

Best regards,

Product Management

subject: Complaint: Transport Damage to Shipment #4920
content:
Dear Mr. Davies,

Unfortunately we must inform you that shipment #4920 (butter fudge cubes) arrived today at our Hamburg warehouse in an unacceptable condition.

Initial inspection suggests the cold chain was severely interrupted during transport. The goods have fused into a single block and are therefore unsellable. A detailed photo record of the damage is attached to this email.

We request your prompt response on this matter, along with proposals for how to proceed with the claim.

Kind regards,

Logistics Department

subject: Invitation to Internal Tasting: New 'Chili-Mango' Product Line
content:
Dear colleagues,

the Product Development department is pleased to present the results of the past few weeks. We have been working on a new, exotic flavor: 'Chili-Mango'.

To finalize the recipe, we need your valued opinion. From 12:00 pm we will have samples available for blind tasting in the central break room.

We would especially appreciate feedback on the balance between the sweetness of the fruit and the heat of the chili. You can note your feedback directly on the questionnaires provided.

We look forward to your active participation.

Your Development Team

subject: Payment Approval: Organic Vanilla Extract Invoice
content:
Good morning Mr. Miller,

please find attached the current invoice from our supplier in Madagascar for the last delivery of organic vanilla extract.

I have checked the goods received and the delivery is complete and in perfect condition. Please arrange payment as a priority so we can keep the early payment discount. Given the currently rising raw material prices for real vanilla, it is important that we secure our favorable terms.

Thank you for your support.

Raw Materials Purchasing

subject: Proposal: Autumn Campaign and Secondary Placement
content:
Dear Ms. Miller,

thank you for the pleasant call yesterday. As discussed, please find enclosed our detailed proposal for the upcoming autumn campaign.

We propose a secondary placement of our soft caramels in your stores, supported by our new display stands in a 'vintage look'. Early test markets have shown that this design significantly increases impulse purchases.

You will find the detailed terms as well as the dimensions of the display stands in the attached PDF. Please do not hesitate to reach out with any questions.

Kind regards,

Key Account Management

subject: Critical Temperature Rise in Warehouse B
content:
Hello Mr. Bauer,

I need to flag an urgent problem in Warehouse B. The temperature sensors have been reporting a constant 24 degrees Celsius for over an hour now.

For the unpackaged goods stored there, this temperature is too high. There is a risk that the caramel mass will lose its shape stability. Please check the air conditioning system immediately and initiate emergency measures if necessary.

Please let me know as soon as the problem has been identified.

Many thanks,

Warehouse Management

subject: Inquiry: Spare Part Procurement for Cutting Machine Type C
content:
Dear Sir or Madam,

we require a replacement part for the Series 400 extruder used in our production. Specifically, we need the cutting blade for the Type C cutting machine.

The currently installed blade shows signs of wear, which is causing uneven cut edges on our toffees. To maintain product quality, a prompt replacement is essential.

Could you please let us know whether you have this part in stock and provide a quote including delivery time?

Kind regards,

Technical Purchasing

subject: Invitation to Interview and Trial Work Day
content:
Dear Mr. Klein,

thank you for your application and your interest in joining our company. Your résumé, and in particular your experience with processing sugar masses, caught our attention.

We would be glad to meet you in person and hereby invite you to an interview including a short trial work day at our facility. We would suggest next Wednesday at 10:00 am.

Please let us know briefly whether this time works for you.

Kind regards,

Human Resources

subject: Quality Deviation: Lab Report Batch 882 (Salted Caramel)
content:
Dear Quality Assurance team,

this morning's analysis of Batch 882 ('Salted Caramel') unfortunately showed a deviation from specification.

The salt content according to the lab report is 1.8%, whereas our standard value is defined at 1.5%. Please have the retained samples tasted immediately to determine whether the product is still within acceptable tolerance or must be held.

We expect your report by 2:00 pm.

Kind regards,

Lab Management

subject: Escalation: Customer Complaint Regarding Packaging Material
content:
Hello Customer Service team,

I am forwarding a phone complaint we received today. A customer reported that on the 'Classic Cream' bag (best before 12/2025), the wax paper barely releases from the candy.

This could point to a problem with the coating on the new batch of paper. Please log the case and compare the batch number with other complaints from the past week. Should this occur more frequently, we will need to contact the supplier.

Please keep me updated.

Best regards,

Head of Quality Management

subject: October Monthly Report: Sales Development and Analysis
content:
Dear Executive Board,

please find attached the detailed sales report for October. We are pleased to report that we have clearly exceeded our targets.

Thanks to the successful Halloween campaign, we were able to increase sales by 15% compared to the same period last year. Particularly noteworthy is the success of the black licorice caramels, which sold out early in several markets. A detailed regional breakdown is provided in the attachment.

For the coming month of November, we forecast stable development.

Kind regards,

Controlling Department

subject: Print File Approval: 500g Bag Back Panel
content:
Dear Ms. Cole,

we have completed our final review and approval of the text for the back panel of the new 500g bag. Please find the corresponding files attached.

We would like to ask you again to pay particular attention to the legibility of the nutrition table. Since the bag is made of flexible material and will crinkle, we need to make sure the mandatory information remains clearly readable even when the bag is filled.

Please send us one final proof before the print run begins.

Kind regards,

Marketing & Communications

subject: Cleaning Request: Special Cleaning of the Mixing Production Area
content:
Good day,

please schedule an intensive wet cleaning of the mixing area for this evening, after production ends.

Due to an incident this morning, a container of glucose syrup tipped over. The area has been roughly cleaned, but the floor still has significant sticky residue that poses a safety risk. Mechanical cleaning is required here.

Thank you for your quick support.

Production Shift Lead

subject: Fault Report: Connection Error Scale 4 / ERP System
content:
Dear IT Support team,

we currently have a technical issue on Packaging Line 4. The control scale installed there has not transmitted any weight data to the ERP system for about 30 minutes.

Since we are now forced to log data manually, this is significantly slowing down the packaging process. Restarting the terminal has unfortunately not resolved the issue.

We request urgent investigation and resolution.

Kind regards,

Packaging Production Management

subject: Discussion Needed: 2025 Condensed Milk Price Adjustment
content:
Dear Sir or Madam,

we confirm receipt of your letter regarding the planned price increase for condensed milk next year.

As a long-standing partner and large-volume buyer, we view the announced increase critically. To find a solution that works for both sides and to continue our collaboration, we would like to reopen negotiations.

Would you be available for a call or an in-person meeting next week?

Kind regards,

Head of Strategic Purchasing

subject: Content Proposal: Video Shoot in the Casting Room
content:
Hi Social Media team,

during my walkthrough of production today, I noticed that pouring the liquid caramel mass onto the cooling table looks visually striking. This could work really well for our channels (Instagram Reels / TikTok), for example under a 'Satisfying Process' theme.

Do you think it would be possible to schedule a short shoot for tomorrow without disrupting ongoing operations? I could arrange access to Line 2 from 10:00 am.

Looking forward to your feedback.

Best regards,

Corporate Communications

subject: Meeting Request: Holiday Season Shift Schedule
content:
Dear members of the Works Council,

we are finalizing staff scheduling for the upcoming holiday season. Due to continued high demand, it is operationally necessary to keep production running at a reduced level over the holidays as well.

We would like to present you with a proposal for shift staffing and the corresponding holiday pay rates, and request a prompt meeting to align on this, so that staff have planning certainty.

Kind regards,

HR Management

subject: Transmission of Customs Documents / Clearance Shipment #TK-204
content:
Dear Mr. Fischer,

Following our previous correspondence, please find attached the required customs documentation for the caramel shipment to Tokyo (Reference #TK-204).

We have ensured that all ingredient lists and production certificates comply with current Japanese import regulations. Please review the documents and confirm receipt at your earliest convenience, so we can authorize the release of the container.

Should you require any further information, do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

Export Department

subject: Escalation: Repeated Timesheet Delays in the Packaging Team
content:
Dear HR Team,

I would like to flag a recurring issue with timesheet submissions in the packaging team. For the third month in a row, several employees have submitted their hours after the payroll cutoff, which is causing delays in processing overtime payments.

Could you please advise on the correct escalation procedure, and possibly join our next team meeting to remind staff of the submission deadline?

Thank you for your support.

Packaging Shift Supervisor

subject: Quote Request: Custom Printed Shipping Cartons
content:
Dear Mr. Tremblay,

We are preparing to launch a new export product line and would like to order custom-printed corrugated shipping cartons featuring our company logo.

Please find attached the required dimensions and estimated order quantities for the first production run. Could you provide a quote along with your current production lead time?

We would appreciate your response by the end of the week so we can plan our packaging schedule accordingly.

Kind regards,

Packaging Procurement

subject: Trial Results: New 'Honey-Lavender' Formulation
content:
Dear R&D Team,

the latest trial batch of the 'Honey-Lavender' formulation has been completed, and the results are promising. The lavender aroma is well balanced against the honey sweetness, though two of the five tasters noted a slightly soapy aftertaste at higher lavender concentrations.

I recommend we reduce the lavender extract by 10% in the next iteration and repeat the panel test. Please let me know if you'd like to review the full tasting notes before we proceed.

Best regards,

Flavor Development

subject: Annual Renewal: Product Liability Insurance Policy
content:
Dear Mr. Walsh,

our product liability insurance policy is due for renewal next month, and we would like to review the current terms before confirming.

Given our expanded export activity this year, could you advise whether our coverage limits should be adjusted? We would also appreciate an updated premium quote reflecting our latest production volume.

Please let us know if you need any additional documentation from our side.

Kind regards,

Risk Management

subject: Kickoff: Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Planning
content:
Dear Finance Team,

as we begin preparing the budget for fiscal year 2027, I would like to schedule a kickoff meeting with all department heads to align on assumptions for raw material costs, planned capital expenditure, and headcount changes.

Could you please circulate the budget template and submission deadline to the department heads this week? We should aim to have first drafts ready before the end of the month.

Thank you,

Office of the CFO

subject: Lease Renewal: Warehouse Unit 12, Distribution Park
content:
Dear Ms. Lindqvist,

our current lease for Warehouse Unit 12 at the Distribution Park is due to expire in three months, and we would like to discuss renewal terms.

Given the planned expansion of our export operations, we may also be interested in the adjacent unit should it become available. Could you let us know the landlord's position on a longer-term lease and current market rates?

We would welcome a call at your earliest convenience.

Kind regards,

Facilities & Real Estate

subject: Notice: Mandatory Fire Drill Next Thursday
content:
Dear Safety Team,

as part of our annual compliance requirements, please confirm the arrangements for the mandatory fire drill scheduled for next Thursday at 11:00 am.

Could you circulate the evacuation assembly points to all department heads in advance, and ensure the fire wardens on each floor are briefed? We would also like a short summary report afterward for our safety file.

Thank you for coordinating this.

Operations Management

subject: Contract Renewal: Industrial Electricity Supply Agreement
content:
Dear Mr. de Vries,

our current electricity supply agreement is approaching its renewal date, and given the recent volatility in energy prices, we would like to explore our options before committing to a new term.

Could you provide updated rate proposals for both a fixed-price and a variable-rate contract, based on our historical consumption data which is attached? We are particularly interested in any options that include a share of renewable sourcing.

We look forward to your proposal.

Kind regards,

Procurement - Utilities

subject: Planning: Booth Design for the Sweets & Snacks Expo
content:
Dear Sales & Events Team,

with the Sweets & Snacks Expo coming up in a few months, we need to finalize our booth design and product lineup.

I suggest we feature the Sea Salt Edition and the new Chili-Mango line as centerpiece tastings, along with a small display of our export packaging. Please let me know your preferred booth size and whether we should bring in additional staff for the three-day event.

Let's set up a planning call this week.

Best regards,

Marketing & Events

subject: Inquiry: Additional Contract Manufacturing Capacity
content:
Dear Ms. Garcia,

due to strong demand for our Sea Salt Edition in Southern Europe, we are exploring additional contract manufacturing capacity to supplement our own production.

Could you let us know your current availability for co-packing runs over the next two quarters, along with your minimum order quantities and lead times? We would also need to discuss quality control and recipe confidentiality arrangements.

We would welcome a call to discuss further.

Kind regards,

Supply Chain Management

subject: Update: Trademark Registration for 'Chili-Mango' Line
content:
Dear Legal Team,

as the 'Chili-Mango' product line moves toward launch, could you confirm the status of the trademark registration filed last quarter?

Marketing would like to begin using the name in promotional material and packaging mockups, but we want to make sure we have clearance first. Please let us know if there are any objections outstanding or if we are clear to proceed.

Thank you,

Product Management

subject: Request: Temporary Staff for Peak Holiday Production
content:
Dear Ms. Rossi,

with the holiday production peak approaching, we anticipate needing additional temporary staff on the packaging lines for approximately six weeks.

Could you let us know your current availability for candidates with food production experience, and your standard placement terms? We would like to begin onboarding at least two weeks before the peak starts.

Please send over your standard agreement for review.

Kind regards,

Human Resources

subject: Schedule: New Employee Onboarding - Next Intake
content:
Dear Training Team,

we have five new hires starting across Production and Quality Assurance next Monday. Could you confirm the onboarding schedule, including the food safety induction and the facility tour?

Please also make sure the new starters receive their access badges and PPE before their first shift. Let me know if there's anything you need from the hiring managers ahead of time.

Thank you,

Human Resources

subject: Scheduling: Annual Organic Certification Audit
content:
Dear Ms. Nowak,

our annual organic certification audit is due, and we would like to schedule a date within the next six weeks.

Could you send us the updated documentation checklist so we can prepare our records in advance? We would also appreciate confirmation of whether the audit will be conducted on-site or remotely this year.

Please let us know your available dates.

Kind regards,

Quality Assurance

subject: Review: Annual Evaluation of Packaging Suppliers
content:
Dear Vendor Management Team,

as part of our annual supplier review, could you compile the scorecards for our three main packaging suppliers, covering on-time delivery, defect rates, and pricing trends over the past year?

We would like to discuss the results before renewing any contracts for next year, particularly given the recent quality issues with the wax paper coating. Please schedule a review meeting once the data is ready.

Thank you,

Quality Management

subject: Customs Clearance Query: EU Shipment Documentation
content:
Dear Mr. Lim,

we are preparing a new shipment to our distribution partner in the EU and want to confirm the customs documentation required on our side.

Could you advise whether the certificates of origin and ingredient declarations from our last shipment are still valid, or whether updated versions are needed given the recent regulatory changes? We would like to avoid any delays at the border.

Please let us know what you need from us.

Kind regards,

Export Department

subject: Draft Review: Press Release for the Chili-Mango Launch
content:
Dear Communications Team,

attached is the draft press release announcing the launch of our new Chili-Mango product line. Could you review it for tone and make sure the quotes from the Product Development lead are accurate?

We are aiming to distribute it to trade press by the end of next week, so please share any feedback by Wednesday. Let me know if you'd like to include a comment from the Executive Board as well.

Thank you,

Product Management

subject: Booking Request: Weekend Print Advertisement
content:
Dear Advertising Team,

we would like to book a quarter-page advertisement in this Saturday's edition to promote our autumn caramel collection in local stores.

Could you confirm availability and send over the current rate card along with the file specifications for print-ready artwork? We would need to submit final artwork by Thursday at the latest.

Please let us know if that timeline works.

Kind regards,

Marketing & Communications

subject: Schedule: Conveyor Belt Repair on Packaging Line 2
content:
Dear Engineering Team,

the conveyor belt on Packaging Line 2 has been slipping intermittently during the last two shifts, causing minor jams at the wrapping station.

Could you schedule an inspection and repair before the weekend, ideally during a planned downtime window so we don't disrupt the current production run? Please let the shift supervisor know once a time has been confirmed.

Thank you,

Production Management

subject: Order Confirmation Request: Dark Couverture Chocolate
content:
Dear Mr. Dubois,

we would like to place our quarterly order for dark couverture chocolate, in the same specification and quantity as our last shipment.

Could you confirm current availability and the expected delivery window? Given the strong demand for our chocolate-caramel line this quarter, we would appreciate an expedited delivery if possible.

Please send an updated invoice once the order is confirmed.

Kind regards,

Raw Materials Purchasing

subject: Proposal: Reducing Plastic Use in Secondary Packaging
content:
Dear Sustainability Team,

following the sustainability targets set out earlier this year, I would like to propose replacing the plastic overwrap on our multipack boxes with a recyclable paper-based alternative.

We have already had informal conversations with our packaging supplier about feasibility and cost. Could you help coordinate a small-scale trial before we present the proposal to the Executive Board?

Happy to discuss further whenever convenient.

Best regards,

Packaging Development

subject: Request: Results for Sample Batch 915 Analysis
content:
Dear Laboratory Team,

we submitted sample batch 915 (Sea Salt Edition) for shelf-life and microbiological analysis two weeks ago and wanted to check on the status of the results.

As this batch is scheduled for release next week, we would appreciate receiving the report as soon as it's available. Please let us know if any additional samples or documentation are required from our end.

Thank you for your support.

Quality Assurance

subject: Preparation: Renewal Negotiation with Major Retail Partner
content:
Dear Key Accounts Team,

our annual contract renewal discussion with our largest retail partner is coming up next month, and I would like to prepare our negotiation position in advance.

Could you pull together the sales volumes, margin trends, and any promotional performance data from the past year? It would also help to have a summary of any complaints or delivery issues raised by the retailer, so we can address them proactively.

Let's schedule a prep meeting once the data is ready.

Kind regards,

Sales Management

subject: Follow-up: ERP System Upgrade Proposal
content:
Dear Sales Team,

thank you for the demonstration of your updated ERP module last week. We are particularly interested in the improved inventory forecasting features for our packaging lines.

Could you send over a detailed proposal including implementation timeline, data migration approach, and pricing for our company size? We would also like to understand what support is available during the transition period.

We look forward to your proposal.

Kind regards,

IT Department

subject: Schedule: Quarterly HVAC Filter Replacement
content:
Dear Maintenance Team,

it's time for the quarterly replacement of the HVAC filters across the production and warehouse areas, as required by our air quality protocol.

Could you schedule this for a low-activity period, ideally over the weekend, and confirm once the replacement filters have been ordered? Please also log the completion in the maintenance system for our next audit.

Thank you,

Facilities Management

subject: Feedback Requested: New Resealable Pouch Prototype
content:
Dear Product Development Team,

we have received the first prototype of the resealable pouch for the multipack line, and initial handling feels promising.

Could your team run it through the standard drop-test and seal-integrity checks before we share it with Marketing for consumer testing? We would like to have preliminary results within two weeks if possible.

Please let me know if you need additional samples from the supplier.

Best regards,

Packaging Development

subject: Agenda Request: Next Board Meeting
content:
Dear Executive Assistant,

could you please circulate a call for agenda items ahead of next month's board meeting? I would like to include an update on the export expansion, the Q4 budget review, and the sustainability packaging proposal.

Please also confirm the meeting room booking and check whether any board members will be joining remotely, so we can arrange the video conferencing setup in advance.

Thank you for coordinating.

Office of the CEO

subject: Reminder: Quarterly Inventory Count Next Weekend
content:
Dear Warehouse Team,

this is a reminder that the quarterly full inventory count is scheduled for next weekend. Could you confirm staffing levels for both Saturday and Sunday, and make sure the counting sheets and scanners are ready in advance?

Please also let Finance know once the count is complete so the stock valuation can be updated before month-end close.

Thank you for your preparation.

Operations Management

subject: Preparation: Upcoming Quality Management System Audit
content:
Dear Internal Audit Team,

our quality management system audit is scheduled for later this month, and I would like to make sure all departments are prepared.

Could you circulate the checklist of documentation each department needs to have ready, and flag any open corrective actions from last year's audit that still need closing out? A short reminder to department heads two weeks before the audit date would also be helpful.

Thank you,

Quality Management

subject: Reminder: Annual Data Privacy Training Deadline
content:
Dear Compliance Team,

this is a reminder that the annual data privacy training module is due to be completed by all employees by the end of the month.

Could you send a reminder to department heads listing the current completion rates for their teams? Please also confirm whether the updated module reflecting last year's policy changes has been fully rolled out.

Thank you for coordinating this.

Human Resources
